candidate.user_submission: This child is 18 months old. The child has cough or difficult breathing. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child is not convulsing now. The child has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child does not vomit everything. The child does not have diarrhoea. The child does not have ear problem. The child does not have fever. I counted the breaths for one full minute before giving the bronchodilator and the rate was 45. I completed the bronchodilator trial. Pulse oximeter was not available. The child does not have recurrent wheeze. The child does not have stridor when calm. The child has wheezing.
